status: provisional original design for integration; not selected for fabrication
narrative: Speaker cycle specialist with stop-and-shoot fallback

frames.robot: origin ground at chassis center; +X forward, +Y left, +Z up
frames.world: use shared artifact world/target transforms; do not reset exit state

intake.status: endpoint volumes only; swept mechanism and piece transition require CAD

shooter.rangeBasis: design travel proposal, NOT measured NOTE tolerance
shooter.releaseRule: NOTE body pitch and velocity elevation equal releasePitch at ideal guide departure; no separate favorable body-angle override
shooter.spinBasis: must derive from contact/unequal wheel motion or measured release; not assumed stabilized
shooter.requiredSpeedBasis: geometric candidate only; motor/contact achievement unverified

states.action: deploy cassette; reverse-capable intake inward; monitor entry detection
move piece to independent retained sensor; bounded timeout
stop capture and retract; confirm stow switch and position plausibility
drive to source-registered shot pose; shooter spinup may run concurrently within power budget

states.guard: fresh redundant pose/rpm evidence, retained piece, verified release envelope, no thermal/current/resource conflict
states.action: feed once; confirm clear; inhibit if any guard lost
stop feed; one bounded reverse attempt only if path clear; otherwise driver alert and abort

allowedCandidate: drive + aim when swept envelope clear
concurrency.fallback: stop-and-shoot; no release when envelope unknown

alternatives.tradeoff: less hardware, common failure point; capture/release operating points and reorientation need proof
recovery redundancy costs mass/space; add only after failure evidence
placement/lift requires verified Amp geometry; do not repurpose Speaker evidence

reliability.response: inhibit affected function; inspect with energy isolated; record component revision, symptom, action and retest
reliability.limits: no inferred impact capacity, fatigue life or vibration diagnosis; no blanket per-match threadlocker

releaseAcceptance: unresolved: whole-piece sweep, physically derived release/spin, complete target registration and roof/wall checks
pieceVariation: measure actual new/worn pieces before tolerance or contact robustness claims
